description: Label Preview. Preview a thermal label via GET. Pass the same label object as a URL-encoded JSON string in query. Inside that JSON, text items use content and size (1-10), not text or fontSize. Prefer format=png for ChatGPT. Credit cost: 3 credits per call.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

format.description: Use png so ChatGPT can display the image. svg is for download or infinite scale. Allowed values: svg, png. Default: "svg".

query.description: Full label config as URL-encoded JSON. Must include width and elements. Text items use content and size (1-10), not text or fontSize.

share.description: If true, persist the result and return share URLs instead of an image. Leave false to get the image. Default: false.

name: label
title: Label Preview
